subset_method: Retain every original Wikipedia row matching guesses.txt. Keep the original occurrence count, with no frequency cutoff. Missing words have no recorded Wikipedia count and can still be curated targets.
known_pool_source: Supplied WordSet data/known_pool.txt; lowercase five-letter entries from the included SCOWL/ESDB size-60 US export.
blocklist_source: Supplied WordSet lists/answer_blocklist.txt, adapted in that project from LDNOOBW and manual exclusions.
plural_subset_method: Parse noun (<n>) source lines with the matching ESDB parser. Retain ns/nss forms in the union of sources/known_pool.txt and guesses.txt, at all ESDB sizes. Match plural and lemma by Spellings.key() and variant number within each blank-line-delimited group, regardless of row order. Record source line and lemma. The snapshot is independent of target-selection policy.
curation_method: Explicit assistant familiarity review of distinct-letter candidates from the conservative and broad supplied dictionaries. An alphabetical approval manifest determines all 2,000 targets; Wikipedia frequency only orders the optional review report. Exclusions are recorded separately. No recognition survey or numerical familiarity score is claimed.
